# Khwaja Hussain Shaikh

> Khwaja Hussain Shaikh (also: Khwaja Shaikh, KHS) is a Full Stack Developer from Mumbai, India, specialising in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) and Next.js. He works at ZAR Luxury Pvt. Ltd. (since Dec 2025), has built 8 live production websites, holds a BCA from Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth (CGPA 8.30, Department Topper) and won the Tech Shaastra Hackathon in 2024 and 2025. Open to freelance, contract and full-time roles (Mumbai or remote).

Key facts: Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Email: khwajashaikh703@gmail.com. GitHub: https://github.com/Shkkhwaja/. LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/khwaja-shaikh-960b981b1/. WhatsApp: https://wa.me/917039551617
